verification_scope: Eleven new item-level publisher pages were opened and selected visible body passages inspected; three existing translated-talk identities were reopened and additional body passages inspected. All 14 records are English translated presentations. Verification is limited to the specified published English passages; original Hebrew/Yiddish transcripts, recordings, complete surrounding context, incoming questions, cited works and later outcomes were not independently inspected. The two 3 Tishrei 5744 farbrengens are separate sessions explicitly identified as first and second by the publisher and remain separate Evidence Families.
rights_note: Only concise non-verbatim Hebrew research paraphrases and precise body locators are stored; no protected letter or talk is copied in full.
quality_note: Every proposition is bounded to visible body passages and attributed to the publisher's English translation, not represented as an AI inference or as an independently inspected original-language transcript.
duplicate_audit_scope: The eleven new AIDs were checked against the current content-review queue and reviewed manifests 049–051; none appears in the queue or those manifests. The three AIDs 2515477, 2515007 and 2514886 were found in batch 050 and deliberately enriched in place, preserving their IDs and Evidence Families. The full public-search-index could not be retrieved through the connected GitHub file reader because of its size, so no corpus-wide semantic duplicate audit is claimed. Translations remain derived witnesses.
